title: "data_ingestion"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RODBC)
library(janitor)

# path to unzipped .accdb file
# using normalize path  bc Windows ODBC driver was being weird
db_path <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS201920.accdb")

```

```{r}
# establishing connection to db
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path)

# checking tables inside
table_list <- sqlTables(con, tableType = "TABLE")
print(table_list$TABLE_NAME)

# pulling tables professor suggested
institutional_chars <- sqlFetch(con, "HD2019")
student_financial_aid <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P1") # for pell percentage
student_financial_aid_2 <- sqlFetch(con, "SFA1819_P2") # for net price
fall_enrollment_cip <- sqlFetch(con, "C2019_A")
retention <- sqlFetch(con, "EF2019D")
```

```{r}
# defining peer group of dc schools
target_ids <- c(131159, # american
                131496, # gw
                131469, # georgetown
                167358, # northeastern
                164924, # boston
                193900, # nyu
                190150, # fordham
                196413, # syracuse
                212051, # drexel
                160755, # tulane
                135726, # u miami
                127060, # u denver
                216597) # villanova

# cleaning institutional characteristics
inst_clean_2019 <- institutional_chars |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, instnm, city, stabbr) # instnm is name, stabbr is state abbreviation

# cleaning retention
ret_clean_2019 <- retention |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, ret_pres = ret_pcf) # ret pres measures % of first-time, full-time undegraduates who return to same institution following fall

# cleaning financial aid data
aid_p1_clean <- student_financial_aid |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, pell_pct = pgrnt_p) 
aid_p2_clean <- student_financial_aid_2 |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  select(unitid, avg_net_public = npist2, avg_net_private = npgrn2, net_price_pell_proxy = npis412)
# note npist2 is used (average net price of students awarded grant or scholarship aid) bc npisur8 was not yet introduced
# npis412 is a proxy, it's 0-30k income net price

# joining the 2 aid tables
aid_final_2019 <- aid_p1_clean |> 
  left_join(aid_p2_clean, by = "unitid")

```

```{r}
# calculating herfindahl-hirschman index using c2019_a
hhi_2019 <- fall_enrollment_cip |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(unitid %in% target_ids) |> 
  # filtering for just bachelor's degreees
  filter(awlevel == 5) |> 
  # extrating 2 digit cip code from 6-digit code
  mutate(cip_2 = str_sub(as.character(cipcode), 1, 2)) |> 
  # grouping by school and department
  group_by(unitid, cip_2) |> 
  summarize(dept_total = sum(ctotalt), .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  # calculating share of total degrees for each dept
  mutate(share = dept_total / sum(dept_total)) |> 
  # squaring shares and summing for hhi score
  summarize(hhi_score = sum(share^2)) |> 
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
# merging all 2019 tables
master_2019 <- inst_clean_2019 |> 
  left_join(ret_clean_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(aid_final_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  left_join(hhi_2019, by = "unitid") |> 
  mutate(academic_year = "2019-20")
print(master_2019)
odbcClose(con)
```
